faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at AIIMS Kalyani?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow post at AIIMS Kalyani is 10th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Biological Sciences or an equivalent qualification, or a Graduate degree in Veterinary Science to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Kalyani Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application via Google Form, document submission, shortlisting, a written test and/or interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at AIIMS Kalyani is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q8. Where is AIIMS Kalyani located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Kalyani is located in Kalyani, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply through offline mode?
faq.answer: No, applications for the AIIMS Kalyani Junior Research Fellow recruitment must be submitted strictly through the online mode.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
